QuestionStmt.S: The Cartesian equation of plane through $A(7, 8, 6)$ and parallel to the XY plane is

Solution.S:
The equation of the plane passing through A(7, 8, 6) can be written as:
$$a(x - 7) + b(y - 8) + c(z - 6) = 0 \quad \text{...... (i)}$$

Since the required plane is parallel to the XY-plane, its normal vector has direction ratios 0, 0, 1.

Substituting a = 0, b = 0, c = 1 into equation (i):
$$0(x - 7) + 0(y - 8) + 1(z - 6) = 0$$
$$\Rightarrow z - 6 = 0$$
$$\Rightarrow z = 6$$

Thus, the correct option is C: z = 6.
